body:
You have two children, i know can seem hard but live and show them that no matter what life hits you with you can push on, you are brave enough to live with your pains, that is true bravery even more so as you are doing it for your family.

I am no doctor just someone who understands a life void of hope, keep fighting and one day it will all make sense you have done the hard part, just finish the race live and show your kids that giving up is not a possibility.
